# Priyam Ventures

> Priyam Ventures Private Limited ("Priyam Ventures") is an internet company building for the Creator Economy. Its products have generated over $5M in SaaS and app revenue for creators.

Products from Priyam Ventures are used by teams at HBO, Disney, MrBeast, Sidemen, CoinDCX, GrowthSchool, LinkedIn, Amazon, Cisco, Walmart, IKEA, Marriott, FedEx, Accenture, Volvo Cars, Bosch, Intuit, Palo Alto Networks, SAGE Publishing, New York Post, NYC Department of Education, Wistia, Roche, Capgemini, Bajaj Finserv, Attentive, Physics Wallah and vidIQ. This describes product usage only, not partnerships or endorsements.

## Products

- [Vid.AI](https://vid.ai): AI video. $1M ARR.
- [TubeMagic](https://tubemagic.com): YouTube optimization. $600K MRR.
- [moonn](https://moonn.com): Payments and courses. New.
- More products are in development and not yet announced.

## Also

- [Warplabs](https://warplabshq.com): Building for the Creator Economy.
